response.text:
# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Resume | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure (all five) | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 9 of 10 = 90%**

Item 8 bundles five tools. If each tool is counted separately (14 skills in total), the candidate matches 13 of 14, or about 92.9%. The decision is the same under either method, so this doesn't matter here.

## Decision

**Proceed.** The 90% match is above the 85% threshold.

## Notes

- **Gap:** GraphQL is the only mandatory skill missing. It's worth raising in the interview, since experience with REST API design may make it quick to learn.
- **Nice-to-have (items 11–15):** None appear on the resume (no Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, or public speaking). As instructed, this does not affect the outcome.
